title: Keep public lead intake separate from private CRM access
description:
As a brand operator, I want public visitors to submit requests while only authorized users can access CRM records.

Feature: Private Prospectus access
  Scenario: Anonymous visitor cannot browse CRM
    Given an unauthenticated visitor at the deployed domain or API
    When they request a board, list, individual issue, history or content object
    Then CRM record data is not disclosed
  Scenario: Public intake has a narrow capability
    Given a configured public contact or demo intake path
    When a visitor submits a valid request
    Then the system records it in the configured tenant and project
    And the response provides no listing, arbitrary issue read or update capability
  Scenario: Authorized CRM usage
    Given a verified authorized CRM identity
    When the user accesses the configured tenant
    Then permitted issue reads and mutations succeed
    And forged or cross-tenant credentials and object references are rejected
